end.summary:
Interpreted position-time and velocity-time graphs as motion stories.
Distinguished flat x-t and v-t lines: constant position versus constant velocity.
Used v-t slope to find acceleration and area under v-t graph to find displacement.
Read and described piecewise motion, including stopping, speeding up, and returning.
Teach-back was not completed; lesson ended when Ira felt tired.
end.parentNote: Ira practised reading graphs as motion stories rather than as pictures of a path. They explained the difference between flat lines on x-t and v-t graphs, used slope for velocity or acceleration, and calculated displacement from area under a v-t graph. The method of breaking the graph into time sections and describing each section went well; no recorded mix-up remained uncorrected. At home, ask Ira to narrate one short graph section in words before calculating anything.
